title: Silence and Solitude Session Length
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prayer:session practice_type=solitude
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(duration_min) as avg_duration, max(duration_min) as max_duration by _time
| sort - _time
description: Trends how long your silence or solitude sessions last each week.
value: Quiet practices are easy to claim and easy to cut short; timing them helps make them real.
implementation: Label solitude sessions in `prayer:session` and chart weekly average and maximum duration.
visualization: Line chart of weekly solitude session length.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It watches how long you are actually setting aside for quiet, solitary practice each week.
